answer:
I added a page to your Reading log note. Your table and the rest of the note are unchanged.

The page has:
- **Cover-style cards:** each book is a colored cover showing its title and author, with the star rating and finish date underneath. Each cover's color comes from its title, and the newest book is first.
- **Stats:** books in total (5), books finished this year, and your average rating (4.2).
- **Books per month:** a bar chart for the last six months.

The page doesn't show your "Want to read" line, because it's plain text rather than a checklist.

The tool warned that the white text on the covers has no separate dark-mode color. I left it because the covers are dark in both modes, so the text stays readable.
